consequence.statement: GET requests to /ingester/shutdown are now accepted; this is an additive feature that does not break existing functionality.

original.statement: The /ingester/shutdown endpoint now supports GET requests in addition to any previously supported methods.

decision.reason: [ev-c9996d6ffec2] lists this under 3.0.0 Features as only "support GET for /ingester/shutdown". That makes it an extra HTTP method on an existing endpoint, with nothing failing, rejected, ignored or needing migration. Consequence kind "none" (informational) fits what the evidence shows. Calling a failure kind or even behavior-change would claim more than the evidence supports.
